data.description:
Child of the launch epic (tuh-01KZEPBEE8HFDQVK96AV6RN0ER). Blocked on the strategy grill (tuh-01KZEPBEE8HFDQVK96AQNCQF4G) and on the docs-swap task (tuh-01KZF1DNJ3T77A01NJXF1VKK4J), which creates the content root the site consumes. The original prose gate ("v0 dogfood week held + PR flow exercised") was satisfied and replaced by the grill edge at the 2026-08-07 launch-epic structuring.

DECIDED at capture (2026-07-31 intake) — inherited, not re-litigated: the site lives IN THIS REPO as a self-contained site/ directory — monorepo — because tuhdoo's ledger is repo-scoped: site work in this repo stays steerable from this backlog, while a separate repo would need its own tuhdoo instance and split the steering surface. Guardrails: site/ owns its package.json and tooling; the Go module never references it; test.yml unchanged; any workflow file triggers the eyes-on-review law.

RECORDED from the strategy grill (2026-08-07):
- Item 5, docs content contract: published docs live at root docs/ (NOT under site/); content is GFM + YAML frontmatter restricted to title + description; cross-doc links are relative paths to real .md files with GitHub rendering as the semantic baseline. The site consumes ../docs at build time, rewrites .md links to routes, and owns navigation/ordering entirely in its own config. The site adapts to the content, never the reverse.
- Item 4, one site or two: ONE site at launch — marketing + docs together. Split-ready later by construction: the content contract makes a future move of docs to e.g. Mintlify a config exercise, not a migration. Mintlify-later is an option kept open, not a plan.
- Item 1, framework: Next.js (Brandon's call — habit and marketing strength, challenged against Astro's better contract fit and chosen anyway; the accepted trade is that the docs pipeline is our responsibility). Docs rendering via a THIN unified/remark pipeline in the app: established plugins only (remark-parse, remark-gfm, remark-frontmatter, remark-rehype) plus a small link-rewrite visitor turning relative .md links into routes; fs-read of ../docs at build; sidebar/prev-next are small site components driven by the site-owned nav config. HARD CONSTRAINT: content is parsed as GFM, never MDX — plain markdown that renders fine on GitHub must never break the site build. No Fumadocs/Nextra.
- Component discipline (Brandon, 2026-08-07): the docs renderer is assembled from a DISCRETE, explicitly-listed inventory of small, light, easy-to-maintain components — heading, paragraph, code block, list, table, blockquote, link, image, and the like — with the GFM-element→component mapping in one file a reader can take in at a glance. No sprawling component tree.
- Item 2, hosting/deploy: Vercel via its GitHub App — project root directory site/, production deploys from main, preview deploy per PR, ZERO .github/workflows files. Vercel's PR checks are additive; the ruleset's required test check is untouched. Posture: every page statically generated (no server runtime used); hard output:'export' deferred unless portability demands it.
- Item 3, domain: tuhdoo.com — already Brandon's (Namecheap, registered 2026-03-26, expires 2027-03-26). Vercel project creation and DNS wiring are the human-led child task tuh-01KZF2D3MA0P24WKAWK89J0Q0X, which depends on this task landing a buildable site/.

The ask: build the marketing/docs site under site/ per the decisions above.

Acceptance: site/ builds and deploys on Vercel per the recorded path, rendering docs/ per the contract (GFM pipeline, .md links rewritten to routes, nav config site-side); the docs renderer is the discrete component inventory with its mapping legible in one file; marketing landing page live; the Go side of the repo untouched (make test lint green, no Go-module reference to site/); zero new .github/workflows files.

Cross-links: the site/ work is the designated first live test of the monorepo-grain question (tuh-01KZA0VT234XJYVZWT8YFV8XE2, held) — note steering-friction signals as they appear. User-facing docs content is owned by tuh-01KZ9YD2Q9V7BSZJBDGVNYM6QY; workflow-recipes content by tuh-01KYX3KJYP7Y178GH5DJ6JPMRQ. Domain/DNS wiring by tuh-01KZF2D3MA0P24WKAWK89J0Q0X (human-led).

History: captured 2026-07-31 intake; held behind v1-confidence gate; gate declared satisfied and task restructured into the launch epic 2026-08-07; docs content contract recorded from the strategy grill 2026-08-07; framework (Next + thin GFM pipeline), hosting (Vercel, zero workflows), one-site-at-launch, domain (tuhdoo.com, Brandon-owned), and component-discipline decisions recorded same day.
